learnings: Tool errors (API failures) should be distinguished from genuine security uncertainty - an initial successful audit followed by a tool error should not override the initial safe finding when another model completes the full audit
The audit system should track whether disagreements stem from tool failures vs. genuine analytical differences, and weight successful complete audits over failed ones
VCS packages with SKIP checksums are standard AUR practice and should not trigger uncertainty when the source URL matches the declared upstream repository
